verdict.rationale: Custodial stablecoin balances are a fair question for a crypto payments and on/off-ramp platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers on-ramp, off-ramp and swap flows, plus creating an end-user wallet during purchase (moonpay-docs-10). Nothing documents a business-held stablecoin balance or custodial account, and nothing states its availability, geographies or gating.
